label: ANTs ConvertImagePixelType
description:
Convert integer pixel type, scaling intensities to the new dynamic range.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: pixeltype
parameters.description: 0 char, 1 unsigned char, 2 short, 3 unsigned short, 4 int, 5 unsigned int.
parameters.usage: 0 char, 1 unsigned char, 2 short, 3 unsigned short, 4 int, 5 unsigned int. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: Input image. Choose an existing file; the command never modifies it.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Convert integer pixel type, scaling intensities to the new dynamic range. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
